title: Northgate Card Fee Rules — Late Payment, Returned Payment and Cash Advance Fees
content:
These rules govern the fees charged on **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** accounts.

## Late payment fee

**When it arises.** A late fee is assessed only when payments credited by the payment due date total less than the minimum payment due on that statement. The payments credited by the payment due date are the payments credited from the day after the statement closing date through the payment due date of that statement, inclusive, less the returned payments for those payments.

**Amount.** The fee is the card's first late payment fee, or the card's repeat late payment fee when at least one late fee was charged on the account for any of the statements immediately before the statement whose due date was missed — the search covers the card's lookback number of statements — and it never exceeds the minimum payment that was due; the ceiling follows the card's late fee cap basis.

**When no late fee arises.** No late fee is assessed when the minimum payment due was 0.00 or when the only unpaid amount is under billing-error dispute.

## Returned payment fee

A returned payment reverses the credited payment and may carry a returned payment fee of the card's first returned payment fee, or the card's repeat returned payment fee when at least one payment was returned on the account in the six statement cycles before the cycle in which the payment was returned (by statement date), again never more than the minimum payment due for that cycle. Each returned payment carries at most one returned payment fee; the account history shows whether a returned payment fee already refers back to that returned payment.

**Single event.** When a returned payment also causes the minimum payment to be missed, only one fee may be charged for that single event: the late fee is charged and no returned payment fee.

## Cash advance fee

A cash advance fee is the greater of the card's minimum cash advance fee and the card's cash advance fee percentage of the advance.

## Courtesy reversal clause — no longer in force

The clause "one late fee per account may be reversed as a courtesy when the courtesy reversals posted in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date being evaluated are fewer than the card's courtesy waivers per 12 months and the account has no other late fee in the previous six statements; returned payment fees and cash advance fees are never waived as a courtesy" is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current basis for courtesy reversals of late fees.

## Error and ceiling reversal clause — no longer in force

The clause "a fee charged in error, or above the minimum-payment ceiling, is reversed in full as a billing error or for the excess as a regulatory cap correction" is **no longer in force** as a clause of these fee rules. It is superseded by the current basis for reversing fees charged in error or above the ceiling.

## Hypothetical cases

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result under these rules |
|---|---|
| Minimum due 50.00; payments credited by the due date 30.00; no late fee on the statements searched | late fee at the first amount, within the 50.00 ceiling |
| Same, but a late fee was charged for one of the statements searched | late fee at the repeat amount, within the ceiling |
| Minimum due 20.00 and missed | late fee no more than 20.00 |
| Minimum due 0.00 | no late fee |
| Only the disputed amount is unpaid | no late fee |
| A returned payment that also causes the minimum to be missed | the late fee only, no returned payment fee |

superseded_clauses: One late fee per account may be reversed as a courtesy when card_msr_courtesy_waivers_12m is below courtesy_late_fee_waivers_per_12_months and the account has no other late fee in the previous six statements; returned payment fees and cash advance fees are never waived as a courtesy.
A fee charged in error, or above the minimum-payment ceiling, is reversed in full as billing_error or for the excess as regulatory_cap.
